messages:
Maya (CS): Heliome (acct_hel-322) escalated — sales-issued credit noted in PO but not applied. PO# 98023 has note 'Apply Q4 contract promo: 10k credits' but account still shows outstanding balance. Customer says console shows no credit and API apply returns 500.
Jordan (Sales): I attached the PO last week, thought billing processed it. @Ravi can you confirm?
Ravi (Billing): Pulling it up now. PO 98023 is attached but no manual adjustment on ledger. I see promo label 'Q4-SALES-10K' in notes but status is 'unredeemed' — looks like sales added only a PO note, not a billing adjustment.
Maya (CS): Right — customer expects a one-time ledger credit per contract. They tried to apply via Console UI and got an error. Repro reported by customer:
```
POST /v1/admin/apply-credit
body: {"account_id":"acct_hel-322","po":"98023"}
Response 500
{"error":"promo_apply_failed","detail":"Missing promo mapping for PO note"}
```
Priya (Eng): Which region / environment did they hit? Production hosted? Also can you paste any UI error screenshot? If it's a mapping issue we can add defensive message instead of 500.
Maya (CS): Prod EU region. Customer sent the console stack trace and the 500 happens when backend tries to map PO note -> promo code. They didn't have a promo code, just PO note. Error from logs: `promo_lookup.go:87: no mapping for po 98023`.
Jordan (Sales): Sales confirms one-time 10,000 credits per contract. I thought billing would convert to a promo code. I'll post the signed clause here shortly.
Ravi (Billing): I can manually create a ledger adjustment but need the signed contract clause and GL code to post. Also need confirmation whether this is token credits or USD credit on invoice.
Jordan (Sales): Confirmed: 10,000 inference credits as a one-time service credit (tokens). Label: `promo_manual_sales_Q4`. I uploaded the signed contract excerpt to the billing ticket.
BillingBot: Ticket #BILL-4721 created by Ravi. Assigned to billing-team.
Maya (CS): Customer is blocked — they hit quota while we sort full 10k. Requesting emergency free-trial top-up of 1,000 credits to unblock them.
Ravi (Billing): I can push an emergency grant. Applying 1000 emergency credits now, ledger note `emergency_grant:1000`.
Ravi (Billing): Done — tx_id `tx_9832`. Customer reports the extra credits showed up and they can resume testing. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng): Filed ENG-1258 to add a clearer user-facing message when a PO-only promo is detected and to prevent 500. Short-term: I can create a transient mapping from PO 98023 -> `promo_manual_sales_Q4` so the API path succeeds while billing posts the ledger entry.
Ravi (Billing): Manual 10k applied as ledger adjustment `adj_10098`. Invoice updated and reflected in account balance. Linking billing ticket: https://redwood.example/billing/tickets/BILL-4721
Jordan (Sales): Confirmed I pasted the signed clause in the ticket: "Section 3.2 — vendor to grant 10,000 inference credits as one-time service credit upon PO receipt."
Maya (CS): Customer confirmed balance fixed and app behavior back to normal. Will close on our side once billing closes the ticket. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Priya (Eng): Follow-up: will push a small console fix to surface a non-500 error and guidance for CS when PO-notes are present. ENG-1258 linked to sprint.
Ravi (Billing): Closing internal billing ticket after reconciliation. If anyone needs the GL posting details I can share offline.
Maya (CS): All good from customer. Closing escalation.
